inspiration.observed_pattern: A same-connection SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID() retrieves the key generated by the preceding insert.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored metadata regression with one auto-increment table and an aliased LAST_INSERT_ID scalar projection. It removes the original ledger's second column and final-state read so the result-column alias is the only observable comparison beyond the generated value.

fixture_notes: The setup insert advances the generated key to 1; the aliased scalar read must return 1 under the declared created_id column name.
determinism_notes: One fixed setup insert establishes the sequence; the scalar read has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE id_probe (probe_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
